definitions.entry: prior audited RISE_LE30_W20 signal, next open
definitions.slot: fraction of live total NAV per accepted position
definitions.tranche: half at entry; half next open after prior close above EMA21 and theme active
definitions.caps: maximum open positions plus at most two positions per theme
definitions.stop8: prior close at least 8% below original entry; sell next open

limitations: This validates the panic sleeve and handoff incidence, not the normal-book portfolio return.
Tax and USDJPY are excluded here; TQQQ mandate audit handles portfolio currency/tax sensitivity.
